reasoning_traces.think:
The core failure mode of standard APM is its susceptibility to multicollinearity when multiple players frequently co-occur on the court. This leads to unstable coefficient estimates. The penalized variant addresses this by adding an L1 penalty, which induces sparsity and reduces variance at the cost of introducing bias. The optimal regularization parameter λ is selected via cross-validation to balance this trade-off. Empirically, this results in a more interpretable model focusing on the most impactful players, improving predictive accuracy on unseen data.
